resources.string:
This technology is brought to you by Nuchwezi Research. 

The basic idea behind TRAY, is to create a tool that allows one to generate, store, share and analyze a stream of time-stamped strings. In the world of TRAY, we call them "meta eggs", and one could think of a meta egg as a self-contained, particular string with a high information density. 

SO HOW COULD IT HELP YOU? 

Note taking, TODO lists, bookmarking important things, collecting research material (using the "share to TRAY" for text from other apps), and many other things. 

Someone has called TRAY their "living diary", private and secure indeed. 

Note that there's support for Markdown and basic HTML, so you can create well formatted notes if you know some of that stuff too. 

------- METRICS ------- 

Note that Meta-Egg Tray computes and displays some useful metrics for each displayed meta-egg. These metrics are computed as such: 

L: number of lines in the raw text (not to be confused with displayed lines based on processing Markdown) 
C: number of characters in the text 
U: number of unique characters -- case sensitive 
W: number of words in the text (ignores all whitespace) 
S: number of unique words -- case sensitive (ignores all whitespace) 

------- OTHER TIPS ------- 

As you continue to use Meta-Egg Tray, you'll notice that the app does keep track of how many records/eggs you've stored in the app thus far. Experience has shown us that a typical user creating or storing eggs of considerable size might store up to 5000 records before they need to reset and start afresh (otherwise beyond some limit, app might suddently reset itself!). Thus, once we detect that you have hit 1000+ records, we ensure to remind you to back-up or export your meta-eggs to some external storage so as to avoid data loss in case of any storage issues. Otherwise, future versions shall improve on this capacity limit detection and force user to back-up or reset.
